ingredients.name: 2% LashLD

Research that proves 2% LashLD works:

Lash LD in this serum is a mix of Tripeptides and Vitamin B5. 

Tripeptides release glycine (an amino acid) at the hair follicle site required for hair strand creation. 

It also includes Vitamin B5 - which nourishes the follicles to boost hair growth.

- Support the hair structure.

description:
Dual-purpose, 100% eye-safe serum to improve density and thickness of brows and eyelashes for fuller-looking eyes

👉Promotes growth: A potent mix of Anagain, Aminexil, and Redensyl hair-growth ingredients that open up follicles and promote growth.

👉Deeply nourishes: Rich in LashLD - an ingredient meant to strengthen and lengthen your lashes and brows; this serum nourishes follicles to give you healthier growth.

👉Thicker lashes and brows: Apply it twice daily for thicker and longer lashes and brows.

👉Easy application: This serum has a mascara-like applicator, making it easy to apply on the lash line and brows.

👉100% safe: We understand the worry about putting anything near your eyes. Rest assured, this serum is 100% eye-safe and clinically tested. Free of fragrance and alcohol, it will cause NO IRRITATION OR INFECTION. 

✅We source all our ingredients from leading global suppliers. Key ingredient Anagain is sourced from the USA

Step 1: On cleansed skin, apply a thin layer along the lash line and brows.
Step 2: For best results, apply twice a day, daily.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Since every skin type is different, we recommend doing a patch test before incorporating it in your routine.

faqs.question: Will it irritate my eyes?
faqs.answer: Be Bodywise Brow & Lash Growth Serum is made with 100% eye-safe ingredients; we recommend applying this with closed eyes, on the outside of the lash line, and on the brows.

faqs.question: Can I apply makeup after applying this?
faqs.answer: We would recommend to wait till the serum absorbs into your skin, once done, you can apply makeup.

faqs.question: How long till I see visible results?
faqs.answer: We recommend using this regularly for 3 months to see visible results.
